items.title: DISTRESS
items.quote: May Hashem answer you on the day of distress.
items.text: No matter how difficult your situation in life becomes, you should call upon Hashem to help you. If those you love are in distress, pray to Hashem to help them and respond to their tefillos.

items.title: KEEPING THE PROMISE
items.text: Over the course of Yaakov’s life he faced many difficult challenges. But Hashem promised to protect Yaakov and He kept His promise. Therefore, you should humbly turn to Him to do the same for you.

items.title: THE SOURCE OF HELP
items.quote: May He send your help from the Mikdash.
items.text: The true yeshuah will come only from Hashem. Don’t rely on help from the nations of the world.

items.title: YOUR PLANS
items.quote: May He fulfill your every plan.
items.text: If you are planning a worthy project, ask for Hashem’s help in bringing success.

items.title: JOY IN VICTORY
items.quote: We will sing joyously because of Your deliverance.
items.text: Express your gratitude to Hashem in public song.

items.title: MILITARY POWER
items.quote: We call out the Name of Hashem, our G-d.
items.text: Don’t rely on the force of arms to save you in time of distress. Turn to Hashem.

items.title: ANSWERING THE CALL
items.quote: May the King answer us on the day we call.
